summary.text: Lisa Holliday Harris is a write-in Republican candidate for Kentucky House of Representatives District 43 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Democrat Robert LeVertis Bell.
She also ran in the 2026 nonpartisan primary for Louisville mayor, where she received 2.4% of the vote.

paragraphs.text: Harris earned a high school diploma from Abraham Clark High School and an associate degree from Bauder College in 2004.
In a Ballotpedia survey she described herself as a Portland-area resident, nonprofit executive, transportation professional and faith leader with more than 20 years of experience.
She said she founded Fox Advocates, is president of Safehouse Kentucky, works as a transportation lead, and serves on Louisville's commission for persons with disabilities.

Harris said she is running as a Republican who could work within the Republican legislative majority, and that her campaign focuses on collaboration, responsible use of taxpayer resources, economic opportunity and public safety.
